links.outcome: LLM diagnostic behavior when patient cases are incomplete or missing information
links.effect: Current LLMs often yield multiple, similarly likely diagnoses, especially when patient cases are incomplete or relevant information is missing; no numbers given for this result.
links.quote: In our experiments, we first demonstrate the limitations of current LLMs in medical reasoning, which often yield multiple, similarly likely diagnoses, especially when patient cases are incomplete or relevant information for diagnosis is missing.

unlisted_practices: Agentic information-seeking that generates follow-up questions chosen by highest expected information gain to reduce diagnostic uncertainty (diagnostic errors reduced by ~27 p.p. vs single-shot LLM baseline)

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks MedClarify, a new agentic architecture/method for iterative medical history-taking and diagnosis using expected information gain, rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
